sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Healthcare and Energy dominate leadership across all timeframes, while Consumer Defensive shows the first signs of fatigue despite its strong broader trend.

Market strength is concentrated in defensive and commodity leadership, with Healthcare (0.900 momentum) and Energy (0.867 momentum) maintaining sustained dominance in the top three across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons. Alongside Consumer Defensive, these groups represent the only 3 of 11 sectors exhibiting all-green performance across the week, month, quarter, half-year, and YTD. 

Meanwhile, rotation remains muted with minor churn at the margins. Consumer Cyclical and Real Estate gained a single spot over the last five sessions, but overall momentum remains firmly skewed against cyclicals and communication names. Communication Services continues to plumb the bottom with zero momentum (0.000) and the lowest rank overall (11).

## Strength
- **Healthcare** anchors the market with the highest momentum score of 0.900, an all-green profile across all timeframes, and sustained top-3 rank dominance.
- **Energy** holds the #1 YTD rank with an 0.867 momentum score, matching Healthcare as an all-green, sustained-strength leader.
- **Breadth remains narrow**, with only 3 of 11 sectors (Healthcare, Energy, Consumer Defensive) positive across all trailing periods from one week through YTD.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Healthcare** (+1 spot to rank 3, momentum 0.900), **Real Estate** (+1 spot to rank 7, momentum 0.450), and **Consumer Cyclical** (+1 spot to rank 10, momentum 0.367) were the week's only rank gainers.
- **Communication Services** is the market's clear anchor, falling 1 spot to rank 11 with a momentum score of 0.000.
- **Industrials** (momentum 0.350, rank 6) and **Basic Materials** (momentum 0.417, rank 5) linger alongside Financials (momentum 0.433, rank 8) in the bottom tier of relative strength.

## Divergences
- **Consumer Defensive** is flashing an early-warning fading signal: despite high momentum (0.750) and an all-green profile, its 5-day rank slipped 1 spot to rank 4.
- **Financials** lost ground (-1 spot to rank 8) with subdued 0.433 momentum, continuing to diverge downward from higher-ranked peers like Technology (momentum 0.533, rank 2).

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive healthcare and traditional energy maintain dominant multi-timeframe strength, while high-momentum software, internet, and select utilities experience sharp short-term rank deterioration.

Market leadership remains tightly concentrated, with only 25 of 144 industry groups demonstrating all-green breadth across all monitored timeframes. Large-cap pharma and traditional energy continue to dictate the upper ranks, anchored by Drug Manufacturers - General (momentum 0.934) and Oil & Gas Drilling (momentum 0.880). Lodging and travel-related groups like REIT - Hotel & Motel (momentum 0.859) also remain entrenched among sustained leaders.

Concurrently, short-term rotation is pulling capital out of regulated yield and digital communications into beaten-down cyclicals. Utilities - Regulated Water plunged 34 spots over the past 5 sessions, while Internet Content & Information collapsed 30 spots into severe laggard territory (momentum 0.099). In contrast, industrials and discretionary pockets such as Engineering & Construction (+22 spots) and Restaurants (+16 spots) are mounting aggressive near-term rebounds despite lower structural momentum profiles.

## Strength
- **Broad-Horizon Leadership:** 25 of 144 groups are all-green across the week, month, quarter, half, and YTD, spearheaded by Drug Manufacturers - General (momentum 0.93), Tobacco (0.87), REIT - Hotel & Motel (0.86), and Oil & Gas E&P (0.85).
- **Persistent Outperformance:** Drug Manufacturers - General, Tobacco, Oil & Gas Integrated, Lodging, Health Information Services, Credit Services, Household & Personal Products, and Information Technology Services all hold top-36 ranks across the 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows.
- **Top Momentum Anchors:** Drug Manufacturers - General (momentum 0.934, YTD rank 22), Oil & Gas Drilling (momentum 0.880, YTD rank 4), and Tobacco (momentum 0.871, YTD rank 23) register the highest absolute momentum scores in the market.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Rapid Short-Term Gainers:** Engineering & Construction jumped +22 spots in 5 sessions to rank 60 (momentum 0.37), followed by Restaurants (+16 spots to rank 92, momentum 0.53), and Auto & Truck Dealerships (+15 spots to rank 110, momentum 0.48).
- **Severe 5-Day Slips:** Utilities - Regulated Water sank -34 spots to rank 73 (momentum 0.42), Internet Content & Information lost -30 spots to rank 120 (momentum 0.10), and Education & Training Services dropped -26 spots to rank 113 (momentum 0.14).
- **Deep Momentum Laggards:** Advertising Agencies anchors the bottom with a 0.026 momentum score (YTD rank 144), followed by Solar (0.086, YTD rank 141), Uranium (0.097, YTD rank 132), and REIT - Mortgage (0.107, YTD rank 135).

## Divergences
- **Fading High-Momentum Groups:** Department Stores shed -15 spots over 5 days despite a 0.60 momentum score; similarly, Biotechnology (momentum 0.67, -11 spots), Healthcare Plans (momentum 0.64, -11 spots), and Waste Management (momentum 0.65, -10 spots) are showing early signs of rank exhaustion.
- **Emerging Low-Momentum Rebounds:** Engineering & Construction surged +22 rank spots while momentum sits at just 0.37, alongside Luxury Goods (+15 spots, momentum 0.40), Auto & Truck Dealerships (+15 spots, momentum 0.48), and Electrical Equipment & Parts (+12 spots, momentum 0.44).
- **Fragile Leadership:** Marine Shipping qualifies as all-green across time horizons but exhibits fragile rank agreement at 0.46.
